role: The firework rocket: right click on a block spawns an EntityFireworkRocket with the stack's NBT; the tooltip lists flight and explosion lines.
scope_reason: world.conf fireworks = off: 'fireworks do nothing'. ItemFirework.onItemUse begins with the WorldConf.fireworks hook and returns false, in the oracle as well.

members.name: onItemUse
members.note: the WorldConf.fireworks hook refuses before anything spawns; EntityFireworkRocket is not ported

notes: The firework crafting recipes themselves are still implemented in crafting.c's fireworks_matches (the recipe is vanilla even though the rocket does nothing), gated by the crafting tests. lane/itemuse: iu-off-s1 uses it with world.conf's switch off (used on the ground and in the air: nothing happens).
